title.zh: 平行麦克斯韦电磁色散残差

summary: Evaluate the causal, signed-wavevector parallel electromagnetic residual for arbitrary species and either fixed circular-polarization sign.

identity.relation: Parallel isotropic kinetic electromagnetic dispersion residual
identity.model: Arbitrary-species drifting isotropic Maxwellian parallel electromagnetic response.
identity.geometry: Real nonzero k along signed z; equilibrium magnetic field along z.
identity.coordinates: Temporal omega in rad/s; k in m^-1; pm fixed in the +z circular basis.
identity.boundary: Retarded Landau analytic continuation from Im(omega)>0.
assumptions: The Gaussian velocity integral gives |k|*vt in both causal denominators, retaining signed k*vd.
No anisotropic or loss-cone substitution is made.

Kinetic constants are caller-owned initialized state: c2, wps2, wcs and vtzs are consumed without conversion; vtzs uses sqrt(2*kB*T/m). No fluid epsilon0/gamma/deck profile is substituted. The source current initialization uses c2=(2.9979e8)^2, epsilon0=8.8542e-12, kB=1.3807e-23, charge-unit=1.6022e-19 C, mass-unit=1.6726e-27 kg, eV-to-J=1.6022e-19; these define a possible predecessor, not new fixed constants in this residual.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Explicit initialized isotropic drifting-Maxwellian kinetic state.
inputs.units: wps2 s^-2; vds,vtzs m/s; wcs rad/s; c2 m^2/s^2
inputs.constraints: wps2 nonnegative; vtzs positive; finite c2. Optional Tzs,Tps must be equal and alphas must be one. Continuation defaults additionally require cwp[m], wcs1[rad/s].

inputs.name: omega
inputs.constraints: Finite scalar before and after binary64 narrowing.

inputs.name: k
inputs.constraints: Real finite and nonzero before and after binary64 narrowing.

inputs.name: pm
inputs.description: Circular-polarization sign about the fixed positive z basis.
inputs.constraints: Exactly +1 or -1. This is not helicity defined along k and is not swapped when k changes sign.

outputs.name: f
outputs.description: Complex unnormalized dispersion residual, first tuple item.

outputs.name: scale
outputs.description: Positive sum-of-term-magnitudes scale, second tuple item.
outputs.constraints: Finite positive; abs(f)/scale is the acceptance residual.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Positive and negative real k, signed drifts and both pm signs.
Generalized nonempty species count with explicit initialized state.
excluded: Complex spatial k, zero k, anisotropic or loss-cone equilibria.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from PDRK beammode EM1D, generalized beyond four species; causal negative-k denominators corrected by independent Gaussian-integral derivation. Canonical maintained plasma dispersion is reused.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.parallel import em1d_parallel_residual
state = dict(wps2=[1.0], vds=[0.0], vtzs=[0.3], wcs=[-0.4], c2=1.0)
f, scale = em1d_parallel_residual(state, 1.2+0.1j, -0.2, pm=-1)
assert scale > 0
example.expected: Finite complex residual and positive normalization scale; this example does not assert a root.

scope: Independent Gaussian velocity-integral signed-k witness and contour holdout.
Positive-domain preservation, drift reflection and both polarization signs.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Near-cancellation scale is a residual normalization, not a root-condition estimate.
Lower-half-plane unrepresentable special-function values are rejected.
